description: Lists every label of one account, system ones (INBOX, UNREAD, STARRED, SPAM...) and user ones, with the ID and the name Gmail uses (nested labels appear as "Parent/Child"). Read-only, one request. Use it before create_label, update_label, organize_emails or create_filter to reuse existing names instead of creating near-duplicates.

account.description: Email address or label of the account (see list_accounts).

name: list_labels
